title: EventNotificationEvents
description: Events published for Notifications (Unit 10) to deliver. Division of responsibility (decision D2): the Events service RENDERS the iCalendar body; Notifications owns SES and delivery. Events never calls SES. Until Notifications is real these events accumulate on the bus — the state is correct and only delivery is pending. EventReminderDue was REMOVED on 2026-08-27 along with the event reminder feature; the calendar invite already puts the event in the member's own calendar, which is where a reminder belongs.

CalendarInviteDue.description: Addressed to ONE recipient on RSVP transition (US-2.8). Distinct from EventUpdated, which is a broadcast about the event itself; conflating them would force Notifications to inspect a discriminator to decide who to mail. `icsMethod=CANCEL` removes the entry from the member's calendar when an RSVP flips yes -> no (BR-C4).

MaterialsAdded.description: A POST-event material was added (BR-M5). Pre-event materials do not notify — they are routine preparation and would spam RSVPs.
